paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure is a donut chart titled "Distribution of Errors with GPT-4," illustrating the breakdown of error types observed in a single run of GPT-4 across all tasks in the Tur[k]ingBench benchmark. The chart is divided into six colored segments, each representing a different outcome or error category, with percentages labeled and connected via lines to their respective segments. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "Incorrect" responses, accounting for 43.6% of the total. The second largest, in red, corresponds to "Correct" responses at 31.6%. Other segments include "Partial" responses in yellow (11.3%), "Syntax Error" in green (2.3%), "Unknown" in orange (8.3%), and "Bad Response" in teal (1.5%). The segments are arranged clockwise around the central white circle, with labels positioned outside the chart and connected by thin lines to their corresponding slices. The visual design emphasizes the dominance of incorrect and correct outcomes, with the remaining error types collectively making up a smaller portion of the distribution.
